svg.aria-label: Shadows in two-point perspective for three sun directions
svg.title: Shadows in two-point perspective for three sun directions

g.text: A · SUN PARALLEL TO THE PICTURE PLANE
Rays keep their true angle (ALT) and stay
parallel. Shadows of vertical edges are
Lit faces toward you; shadows fall away and
are partly hidden. Rays converge to VPs below
the horizon; shadows of verticals converge to
VPsh on it, vertically above VPs.
C · SUN IN FRONT OF THE VIEWER (BACKLIGHT)
Faces toward you are in shade; shadows
come toward you. VPs is the sun itself,
above the horizon; VPsh is directly below it.
